Agent Name: WebServing_Expert  
Step Number: 8  
Reason for Mistake: WebServing_Expert prematurely concluded that none of the fruits depicted in the painting ("watermelon, pears, lemons") were served on the SS Ile de France's October 1949 breakfast menu. This conclusion was based on the lack of explicit mentions of these fruits on the menu, despite the menu containing a general "Fruit" category. The expert failed to explore the possibility that some of the fruits from the painting could have been included under this general category, leading to an incomplete and potentially inaccurate conclusion. A more thorough investigation into what fruits were typically served under "Fruit" on such menus during that period was necessary to avoid the error.
